subject: Promo credit approval & invoicing treatment for Nebula trial extension
messages:
From: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
To: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>; Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Cc: Alex Chen <alex@nebula-analytics.com>
Date: Wed, 12 May 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Nebula — promo credit & trial-extension (ask for accounting path)

Hi Mina / Laura,

Quick one — Nebula Analytics (Alex, cc'd) asked us to extend their trial by 45 days and cover the overage that occurred during onboarding. The commercial ask is a $9,750 promotional credit plus the extension; they want it applied to the May invoice if possible.

Can finance advise whether we should:
- Issue a credit memo against the outstanding invoice (preferred by customer)
- Or record an allowance/contra-revenue and keep billing as-is until month-end

Relevant items attached: proposal_nebula_trial_extension.pdf (simple sum sheet) and a sample invoice from Nebula (nebula_invoice_sample.csv). The deal id is NEB-2027-047.

Notes: customer will sign a short amendment confirming the extension; they asked for turnaround within 72 hours so they can close the month. If there are any GLA requirements or special journal entries we should be aware of, please flag.

Thanks — Marcus
Marcus Lin
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
From: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>; Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>; Alex Chen <alex@nebula-analytics.com>
Date: Wed, 12 May 2027 11:03:27 -0700
Subject: Re: Nebula — promo credit & trial-extension (ask for accounting path)

Marcus — thanks for the context and the attachments.

High-level guidance before accounting posts this:
1) This looks like a promotional allowance tied to a specific customer action (trial extension). Generally we treat these as contra-revenue (allowance) rather than straight refunds unless the invoice has already been paid and customer requests a cash refund.
2) If the May invoice is still open/unpaid and we can apply the credit immediately, billing can process an invoice offset using the credit memo number and apply to the open AR. If the invoice was paid, we will need to issue a formal credit memo and the customer will either consume it against future invoices or request a refund.

Action items for Marcus: please confirm (a) whether the May invoice is unpaid, (b) expected amendment signature ETA, and (c) whether Nebula will provide a PO referencing NEB-2027-047.

Neha — can you confirm the GLA mapping we should use for a promotional allowance here and the preferred journal entries? If we can get an approval email from Laura (or myself) once Marcus confirms the invoice/PO status, finance can generate the credit memo or instruct billing to offset the invoice.

Alex — appreciate the quick turnaround; if you can upload the signed amendment to the shared Drive link (or reply to this thread with the signed doc), that will speed things up.

Attachments referenced: nebula_invoice_sample.csv (Marcus)

Thanks,
Mina Haddad
Finance Business Partner, Redwood Inference
From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
To: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>; Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>

Date: Thu, 13 May 2027 08:45:10 -0700
Subject: Re: Nebula — promo credit & trial-extension (ask for accounting path)

Mina / Neha —

Approve conditional treatment as follows:
- If May AR is unpaid: instruct Billing to apply the $9,750 as an invoice offset (credit memo linked to invoice). Use customer AR reference NEB-2027-047 on the offset.
- If May AR is paid: generate a formal credit memo, GLA = 6105 (Promotional Allowances), and record contra-revenue in the same period the credit is recognized.

Please note: we require the signed amendment and a PO (if Nebula has one) before issuing any credit memos. Marcus, please attach the signed amendment to the Drive folder below and mark the invoice status. Once documents are uploaded, finance will prepare the memo and provide journal entries: DR Promotional Allowances (6105) / CR Accounts Receivable (if offset) or DR Promotional Allowances (6105) / CR Accounts Payable (credit memo liability) as applicable.

Related links: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/FIN-2345 (tracking)
Drive: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1NebulaAmendments

Mina / Neha — once you've created the memo or instructed billing, reply all with the memo number so Marcus can confirm with the customer.

Thanks — Laura
